Keep those recipes consistent across hero panels, cards, and controls so the page reads as one material system. Surfaces should read as flat first, with borders, shadows, and blur only reinforcing that material choice. 技法 复制技法 渐变边框外壳 Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 0px padding and a 0px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 43%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38) 100%), linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 24%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18) 100%) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame. 表面样例 Flat 边框、阴影与模糊处理按生成的层次体系预览。 Surface Flat Border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 形状 形状在卡片、控件与图标处理上保持一致。 图标集 Inline SVG 图标集 Inline SVG 规范与禁忌 遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。 建议 • 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。 • keep spacing aligned to the detected 8px rhythm. • reuse the Flat surface treatment consistently across cards and controls. 避免 • 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。 • 没有明确理由时，不要超过检测到的极简动效强度。 动效 动效保持克制，以界面为主导，覆盖文字、布局与滚动过渡。 时序主要聚集在 900ms 与 250ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1 与 Ease。 动效强度 极简 时长 900ms250ms8000ms 缓动 Cubic 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1Ease 60 FPS 示例过渡 · 900ms WebGL WebGL Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using antialias, DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: noise haze with black and sparse spacing. Build it from shader field so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift.
